title: FBN Program Terms: One Enrollment per Seller
content:
**Clause.** A seller holds at most one Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment; all of the seller's SKUs in the fulfillment network belong to it. A closed enrollment does not count, so a seller who left FBN may enroll again.

## Effect of the clause

- The limit is 1 enrollment per seller.
- Every SKU the seller has in Northloop fulfillment centers is held under that single enrollment; there is no second enrollment to which a SKU could belong.
- An enrollment whose status is closed is not counted against the limit of 1.

## Applying the limit (hypothetical sellers)

| The seller's existing FBN enrollments | Counted against the limit | May the seller enroll again? |
|---|---|---|
| None | 0 | Yes |
| One enrollment, closed | 0 | Yes |
| One enrollment, active | 1 | No |
| One enrollment, winding down after an exit request | 1 | No |

**Basis questions.**

*Does a former FBN seller have to wait before enrolling again?* The clause sets no waiting period: once the earlier enrollment is closed it does not count, and the seller may enroll again.

*Can a seller keep oversize SKUs under one enrollment and standard SKUs under another?* No. All of the seller's SKUs in the fulfillment network belong to the one enrollment.
